description: Composite figure of eight EBSD-derived Schmid factor maps arranged in two rows of four. The top row (panels a1-d1) is labelled "γ" (austenite) by a vertical label at the far left; the bottom row (panels a2-d2) is labelled "B2". Per the caption, columns correspond to increasing strain of 0%, 1%, 3% and 6%. A single colour bar at the right of the group runs from 0.5 at the top (red) through yellow/green to 0.2 at the bottom (blue). Every panel carries a 5 μm scale bar in its lower-right corner; black pixels mark regions with no indexed phase. The austenite maps are densely filled with equiaxed grains of mixed red, orange and yellow scattered with occasional green and blue grains, i.e. a broad Schmid factor distribution weighted toward the high (red-orange) end of the scale. The B2 maps are overwhelmingly black, containing only sparse, elongated grains, mostly orange-red with a few yellow/green ones. No numeric Schmid factor values are printed inside the panels; strain levels and phase assignments come from the caption. The figure demonstrates that austenite and B2 grains carry distinctly different Schmid factors, which the citing text links to their different GND densities and dispersion-strengthening contributions.
measured_quantities: GND density (m^-2), as cited from the text

observations.observation: The group contains eight Schmid factor maps in a 2-row x 4-column layout, with the top row labelled γ (austenite) and the bottom row labelled B2.
A single shared colour bar at the right of the group is labelled 0.5 at its top and 0.2 at its bottom, running blue (low) through green/yellow to red (high).
Each of the eight panels contains its own scale bar annotated 5 μm.
The austenite (top-row) maps are densely filled with equiaxed grains dominated by red, orange and yellow colours, with occasional green and small blue grains.
The B2 (bottom-row) maps are predominantly black, containing only sparse, elongated coloured grains that are mostly orange-red, with a few yellow and green ones.
No numeric Schmid factor value is printed inside any of the individual panels; only the shared colour bar gives numeric anchors.
The caption assigns panels (a1,b1,c1,d1) to the austenite phase and (a2,b2,c2,d2) to the B2 phase, for strains of 0%, 1%, 3% and 6% respectively.

The caption states the figure shows the evolution of Schmid factors for austenite and B2 grains with increasing strain in a duplex lightweight steel; the images alone cannot confirm the strain values of individual panels.
The citing text states that the difference in GND density between austenite grains (G1, G2) and B2 grains (G3, G4) is attributed to their distinct Schmid factors.
The citing text concludes that the Schmid factor is an important parameter influencing the deformation behaviour of individual grains.

The citing text gives Taylor factors M of 3.06 for γ-austenite and 2.75 for the B2 phase, empirical constants α of 0.26 and 0.4, shear moduli G of 70 and 82 GPa, and Burgers vector magnitudes b of 0.260 and 0.248 nm.
The citing text states that from average GND densities obtained from EBSD data (Figure 7) the calculated dispersion-strengthening values σ_dis are 106 MPa for austenite and 227 MPa for B2.
The grains referenced as G1-G4 in the citing text are not individually labelled in the image; no grain identification numbers are visible.

subfigures.description: EBSD Schmid factor map of austenite at 0% strain; densely populated with equiaxed grains coloured mainly red/orange/yellow with scattered green and blue grains, black non-indexed areas, 5 μm scale bar.
Austenite Schmid factor map at 1% strain; grain colour distribution similar to (a1), red/orange dominant with green and blue grains, 5 μm scale bar.
Austenite Schmid factor map at 3% strain; red/orange grains still dominate, black non-indexed regions more visible, 5 μm scale bar.
Column order (0%, 1%, 3%, 6%) is taken from the caption; the individual panels do not print their strain value.
Austenite Schmid factor map at 6% strain; colour distribution comparable to earlier columns, 5 μm scale bar.
B2 Schmid factor map at 0% strain; almost entirely black with a few elongated orange-red grains and one yellow-green grain, 5 μm scale bar.
B2 Schmid factor map at 1% strain; sparse elongated grains mostly orange-red/yellow on black background, 5 μm scale bar.
B2 Schmid factor map at 3% strain; sparse coloured grains, a few small green and blue grains appear among the orange ones, 5 μm scale bar.
B2 Schmid factor map at 6% strain; still mostly black with sparse elongated orange grains, 5 μm scale bar.
Single shared colour scale for all eight panels, labelled 0.5 at the top and 0.2 at the bottom, blue (low) to red (high) Schmid factor.
